answer_2.quote: Metrics. Following prior works, we adopt the metrics for evaluating knowledge updating ability: Efficacy (efficiency success) and Generalization (paraphrase success); for assessing knowledge preservation ability: Specificity (neighborhood success); and for evaluating generation quality: Fluency (generation entropy) and Consistency (reference score).
